articles.summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. (NYSE: IVR) (the "Company") today announced that the Company declared a cash dividend of $0.12 per share of common stock for the month of November 2026. The dividend will be paid on December 14, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on November 24, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of November 24, 2026. Financial Highlights as of October 31, 2026 Total investment portfolio including TBAs of $8.1 billion Unrestricted cash and unencumbered securities of $413.2 million (1) Total repurchase agreement borrowings of $6.7 billion Estimated book value per common share of $7.01 (2) Debt-to-equity ratio of 7.2x and economic debt-to-equity ratio of 7.9x (3) (1) Unrestricted cash and unencumbered securities includes noncash collateral pledged to the Company as margin by its counterparties. (2) Estimated book value per common share as of October 31, 2026 is calculated as total stockholders' equity less the liquidation preference of the Company's Series
articles.title: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. November 2026 Dividend Announcement and October Financial Update
